description: Agent Access: submit a system’s permission design: each permission with every place it is enforced or stated (gateway, policy engine, platform, credential scope, tool code, database, system prompt, tool description or conversation), what the enforcing layer does when it cannot decide or is down, and whether the model can change that layer through a tool. The signed report names every permission enforced outside the model, every permission that rests only on instructions the model can argue with, ignore, or lose in a long context, or on nothing, and every outside enforcement that fails open or that the model can switch off, with the fix for each. Which tool paths skip the gateway is wever_gateway-coverage-check, the rules the gateway enforces are wever_gateway-rules-check and which decisions code should compute is wever_deterministic-core-check. Verdict prompt_only_permissions, enforcement_gaps, enforcement_unverified or enforced_outside_model. POST /api/enforcement-layer-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-access-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-access/.
